title: Retiring NFL receiver Allen Robinson II says he 'learned a lot about myself' during Rams stint

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Retiring NFL receiver Allen Robinson II says he 'learned a lot about myself' during Rams stint
sources.description: Former Pro Bowl receiver Allen Robinson II announced his retirement on his 33rd birthday. In an Instagram video, he mentioned positives from every stop during his NFL career, including the Rams.
